openrouter.free_basis: Both prompt and completion prices reported by the provider are zero.

groq.free_basis: Models available to an account on the provider Free Plan are subject to free-plan rate limits.

cerebras.free_basis: Models exposed to a configured free-tier account are limited by that tier.

gemini.free_basis: Models exposed to a configured Google AI Studio free-tier key are subject to free-tier limits.

github-models.free_basis: GitHub Models provides rate-limited model experimentation at no cost.

pollinations.free_basis: Models exposed to the account consume the provider's free Pollen allocation.

huggingface.free_basis: Inference Providers requests consume the account's monthly free credits.

nvidia.free_basis: Build API access is provided with rate-limited evaluation credits.

mistral.free_basis: Models exposed to an Experiment Plan account are subject to experiment-plan limits.

sambanova.free_basis: Models exposed to a configured Free Tier account are subject to provider limits.

ollama-cloud.free_basis: Models exposed to a configured free-tier account are subject to its usage limits.

modelscope.free_basis: Models exposed to the inference account consume its free inference quota.

xiaomi-mimo.free_basis: Models consume account gift credits; this is a limited credit rather than permanent zero pricing.
xiaomi-mimo.billing_warning: 赠送额度用完后停止使用或按账户计费设置执行，请先确认余额。

volcengine-ark.free_basis: Models consume model-specific trial quota and may become billable after exhaustion.
volcengine-ark.billing_warning: 免费额度按模型限量发放，耗尽后可能转为计费。

baichuan.free_basis: Models consume time-limited new-account gift credits.
baichuan.billing_warning: 新用户赠送金有效期有限，余额耗尽后接口按平台价格计费。

bigmodel.free_basis: The provider documents Flash variants as free models.

qianfan.free_basis: Long-term free models documented by the provider.

siliconflow.free_basis: Models marked free by the provider catalog.

zai.free_basis: Models exposed to the configured free-model account are subject to provider limits.

cloudflare.free_basis: Workers AI includes a daily free allocation measured in Neurons.
